messages:
Asha K: Quick question — can we add a region-aware selector that prefers lowest latency but respects tenant pinning? We need it for multi-region hosted API and to reduce tail p95s.
Tom S: prob yes. We need to clarify preference order: enterprise pinned region > latency-pref > cost-pref > fallbacks. Also what happens if capacity in pinned region hits 100%?
Priya R: Also need to enforce data residency: if tenant has `require_local` flag, router must never cross-region even for latency improvements.
Jorge M: For capacity issues, proposed fallback chain: 1) same-region compatible model variant (e.g., quantized) 2) other-region same-tier full model 3) same-region smaller model (lower quality) 4) cross-region quantized, etc. We should make this configurable per-tenant.
Lindsey P: cost concern: cross-region egress can be expensive. Allow a per-tenant `max_cross_region_bytes_per_hour` or `max_cross_region_pct` setting in billing config.
Asha K: UX — in console rollouts page add a 'Routing policy' card with a small summary and controls: Latency-first / Cost-first / Pin-region. Show effective policy and reason for each request sample.
Tom S: Implementation idea: add a new policy type `region_selector` to the routing API. Example schema:

```json
{"policy": "region_selector",
 "priority": ["pinned_region", "latency", "cost"],
 "latency_threshold_ms": 50,
 "max_cross_region_pct": 0.05}
```

Priya R: Telemetry requirements: emit per-request fields `chosen_region`, `route_reason` (enum), `candidate_latencies` (list), `model_variant_used`, `is_fallback` (bool). Metrics: p50/p95/p999 latencies per-region and per-tenant, cross-region % by tenant, fallback rate.
Jorge M: Agree. Also add `fallback_score` in logs computed as weighted sum: latency_penalty + quality_penalty + cost_penalty. That helps explain why we chose a smaller model vs cross-region full model.
Tom S: Edge case: model variant compatibility. If region lacks int8/quantized kernels for a model, don't pick quantized fallback there. We need a capability registry: region -> runtime features.
Asha K: Correct — capability registry + model capabilities metadata. Router should run `is_compatible(region, model_variant)` before choosing.
Lindsey P: Canary/rollout plan: 0.25% traffic via new policy for 24h, monitor error rates, quality regression (hidden evals), and cross-region cost. Console should show a canary timeline and quick rollback button.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: region-selector-api v0.1 -> staging at 1766001600 :rocket:
Tom S: For observability, tag requests with `routing_decision_trace_id` so we can join traces between router logs and model logs and replay decisions in eval infra. Also store sampled `candidate_latencies` for 1000 reqs/day for debugging.
Priya R: Dashboard items: 'routing outcomes by tenant', 'cross-region bytes by tenant', 'fallback rate by model', alert if cross-region > configured max or if p95 latency increases >20% after policy flip.
Jorge M: Security: signed tenant routing prefs (hash+sig) so a compromised control plane cannot silently change pinning. Also audit log entry for every routing policy change.
Asha K: Action items: Tom to PR API schema + router proto; Priya to spec telemetry events + dashboard panels; Jorge to update capability registry and fallback heuristics; Lindsey to add cost cap to billing proto and console controls. I'll create the tickets and link RFC.
Tom S: I'll open the PR and ping infra for canary window once PR passes CI.
Lindsey P: noted, adding to backlog with high priority. :thumbsup:
Asha K: Thanks all — linking RFC draft: https://redwood/s/rfc-region-selector.
